evidence.title: Best Agent Sandboxes in 2026: Cold Start, Per-Second Pricing, and Network Policy Across E2B, Daytona, Modal, Cloudflare, and Vercel

summary: Top platforms like E2B, Daytona, Modal, Cloudflare, and Vercel are enhancing their AI agent sandboxes with features such as cold start capabilities, per-second billing, and network policy controls. These updates aim to improve efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and security for AI development environments.
title: Leading AI Agent Sandbox Providers in 2026 Introduce Cold Start, Per-Second Pricing, and Network Policies
